faq.a: Ridzuan is associated with the Arabic form رِضْوَان, whose core sense is ridzuan; pleasure, good will (malay form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Ridzuan?
faq.a: Ridzuan is associated with Arabic. Ridzuan is the Malay form of Arabic رِضْوَان (Riḍwān), meaning 'pleasure, good will'; it occurs in the Quran.
Yes — the underlying form رِضْوَان is Arabic.
Ridzuan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ridzuan should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Riḍwān occurs in the Quran as a term for divine pleasure.

faq.q: What does Ridzuan mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Ridzuan is rendered رضوان and carries the sense رضوان، خوشنودی.

faq.q: What does Ridzuan mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Ridzuan is rendered رضوان and carries the sense رضوان، خشنودی.
A romanized syllable approximation is rid-zuan. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Ridzuan?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ridzuan, ridzuan. Script forms are رضوان, رِضْوَان, रिज़वान.

faq.q: Is Ridzuan a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
